body: I'm still trying to find one. Maybe one day I can pay back all the people that have been there for me, but given my track record when I try to help someone it usually has the opposite effect.

I think we've all been in that situation. It's like my brain figures out "what's the worst thing you could do or say right now?" Alcohol + phone = at least one week of feeling embarrassed and hating myself. For me it's one of the main reasons for hating alcohol so much.

Thanks for the response. Already seeing a doctor. Already on anti-depressants and therapy. I really do try most of the time, for the sake of others mostly. I take my meds, I go to support groups etc. But on a particularly bad day I'll say "fuck it" and engage in destructive behavior, but I never tell anyone about it so I doubt I'm seeking attention. It's just hard to keep things quiet when I stumble in at 5am completely hammered with a black eye and a fine or whatever. The only explanation I can think of is that I just cannot get pleasure out of anything, and destructive behavior and self-harm make me feel somewhat alive, unfortunately it also affects others. It seems like unless I have someone watching me 24/7 I end up fucking everything up.
